title: Responsive and consistency gaps on core screens
location: frontend-next/views/BusinessAnalytics.tsx (header at 375 px: 12 px overflow, Google Sheets button clipped)
frontend-next/components/feed/PostCard.tsx (long unbroken text overflows 6 px at 375 px)
frontend-next/views/ProductDetail.tsx (single column at 1440 px; price "850.00" with ETB wrapped)
frontend-next/app/providers.tsx:42 (defaultTheme light ignores the device dark preference)
steps: Screenshots at 375/768/1440 px, light and dark (scripts/browser/reaudit-screens.cjs).
expected: One price format (formatAmount) everywhere; no clipped controls at 320-375 px; desktop product page uses the width (image beside details); labels instead of raw enum values; theme follows the device by default; type sizes from the scale.
impact: Falls short of the big-platform bar for consistency; small but visible on every core journey.
fix: Wrap the Analytics header actions under the title below sm; add break-words to post text; two-column product layout at lg; use formatAmount for every price; map statuses to labels; defaultTheme="system"; replace text-[10px]/[11px] with text-xs or a token.
